references.text: The verse distinguishes between blowing the trumpets to assemble the congregation and sounding an alarm, showing the different meanings of these signals.
The entrance to the Tabernacle (the Tent of Meeting) is mentioned as the place where God spoke to Moses and where the congregation was to gather.
The Tent of Meeting is described as the meeting place between God and the people of Israel.
The entrance to the Tent of Meeting is established as the holy meeting place where God meets His people.
The entire congregation was assembled at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, as described by the blowing of the trumpets.
Korah's rebellion led to the entire congregation being gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
Moses and Aaron went to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to meet the glory of the Lord.
The whole assembly of Israel gathered at the Tent of Meeting in Shiloh, showing the continuation of this practice.
